name: compusync
description: One logical window, shared workspace, and host editor across two laptops.
author: CompuSync

scripts.test:native: node scripts/run-cargo.cjs test --locked --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && node --test native/index.test.cjs
scripts.build: npm run native:build && npm run native:smoke && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:win: npm run native:build && npm run native:smoke && electron-builder --win portable --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run native:build && npm run native:smoke && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: CompuSync connects to your other laptop to share its window and cursor.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: CompuSync needs Accessibility access to move the shared cursor and position Chrome windows during handoff.
extendInfo.NSInputMonitoringUsageDescription: CompuSync needs Input Monitoring access so your mouse and keyboard can follow the shared cursor.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: CompuSync needs Automation access to read and recreate your Chrome tabs during window handoff.
